_how_to: One entry per YouTube video, newest first. Paste the video's link into 'url' (regular videos and Shorts both work; Shorts show in a tall frame). 'watches' or 'things' lists the folder names of the watches, toys or gear it features, so it shows on their pages too. Set "sound": true for ASMR and other sound-first videos: they get the 🔊 tag, and the things in them show under the Sounds filter on The desk. Optional: upload a cover image named after the video id to source/videos (for example xPnFMMdfSJY.jpg) to use instead of YouTube's thumbnail.
